metadata.description: Skills distilled from 50 books on orchestration, harmony, form, counterpoint, mixing and style practice, plus 62 arrangements measured from multitrack recordings — covering composing and arranging popular music end to end, from intent to a spec sheet a generation backend can execute

plugins.name: music-composition
plugins.description: 51 child skills plus one parent entry skill in six layers: workflow and ARR-SPEC; general composition and arrangement craft; original style layers plus 21 Latin genre subskills (salsa, timba, bachata, merengue, reggaeton, dembow, cumbia, regional Mexican, corridos tumbados, Brazilian, tango, Latin jazz and more), a Latin fusion engine, execution and corpus. Includes artist innovation studies, historical lineage and contemporary crossovers. Plain text; output in the question language.
